summary: The document is a non-functional placeholder containing seven vague, subjective statements for a food delivery mobile app. It lacks all technical specifications, user roles, data models, security protocols, and acceptance criteria, rendering it completely unusable for engineering or QA purposes.

risk_factors.title: Total Absence of Security Architecture
risk_factors.description: The document explicitly states 'No security requirements' and provides no guidance on authentication, data encryption, or payment security (PCI-DSS), exposing the system to immediate exploitation and data breaches.
risk_factors.mitigation: Define a comprehensive security architecture including OAuth2.0 for authentication, AES-256 for data at rest, TLS 1.3 for data in transit, and strict PCI-DSS compliance for payment processing.

risk_factors.title: Undefined Data Privacy and Compliance
risk_factors.description: No mention of GDPR, CCPA, or HIPAA (if health data is involved) compliance. Customer PII (location, payment info, dietary preferences) is handled without defined retention, consent, or deletion policies.
risk_factors.mitigation: Implement a Data Privacy Impact Assessment (DPIA), define data retention policies, and ensure explicit consent mechanisms for location tracking and marketing communications.

risk_factors.title: Unmeasurable Performance Requirements
risk_factors.description: Requirement 3 states 'Delivery should happen fast' without defining latency, throughput, or availability SLAs. This makes it impossible to design the backend infrastructure or load-test the system.
risk_factors.mitigation: Define specific Non-Functional Requirements (NFRs): e.g., API response time < 200ms for 95% of requests, 99.9% uptime, and support for 10,000 concurrent users.

risk_factors.title: Ambiguous Payment Integration
risk_factors.description: Requirement 4 states 'Customers can pay somehow.' This lacks specification of payment gateways, supported currencies, refund policies, or fraud detection mechanisms, leading to integration failures and financial loss.
risk_factors.mitigation: Specify supported payment methods (Credit Card, PayPal, Apple Pay), integrate with a specific PSP (e.g., Stripe), and define transaction failure handling and refund workflows.

conflicts_and_ambiguities.suggested_resolution: Replace with measurable UX metrics: e.g., 'App Store rating target of 4.5+ stars, crash-free rate > 99.5%, and task completion time for ordering < 2 minutes.'
Define specific roles: 'Restaurant Admin' (manage menu, view orders), 'Delivery Driver' (accept jobs, navigate), and 'Customer' (order, track, pay). Assign RBAC permissions to each.
Specify notification types: 'Push notifications for order confirmation, driver assignment, and delivery completion. Email receipts for all transactions. SMS alerts for critical failures.'

missing_sections_and_details.why_missing: The core business process (ordering, preparing, delivering) is not defined, making it impossible to design the state machine or database schema.
missing_sections_and_details.recommended_addition: Detail the order state transitions: 'Placed' -> 'Confirmed' -> 'Preparing' -> 'Out for Delivery' -> 'Delivered' -> 'Completed'. Include edge cases like 'Cancelled' or 'Refunded'.

missing_sections_and_details.why_missing: No entities (User, Restaurant, Menu Item, Order, Payment) are defined, leading to inconsistent database design and API contracts.
missing_sections_and_details.recommended_addition: Provide an ERD or JSON schema for key entities: User (id, name, email, address), Restaurant (id, name, location, menu), Order (id, user_id, items, total, status).

missing_sections_and_details.why_missing: No definition of how the mobile app communicates with the backend or third-party services (maps, payments, SMS).
missing_sections_and_details.recommended_addition: Define RESTful API endpoints (e.g., POST /orders, GET /restaurants) with request/response examples. Specify integrations with Google Maps API for geolocation and Stripe API for payments.

missing_sections_and_details.why_missing: Lack of performance, scalability, and availability targets prevents proper infrastructure planning and load testing.
missing_sections_and_details.recommended_addition: Specify: 'System must handle 1,000 TPS during peak hours. Data must be backed up daily. Mobile app must support iOS 14+ and Android 10+.'

ai_recommendations: Completely discard the current document and initiate a formal requirements gathering workshop with stakeholders to define specific, testable functional and non-functional requirements.
Create a detailed User Story map for the Food Delivery App, covering all user roles (Customer, Restaurant, Driver) and their interactions with the system, including edge cases and error handling.
Develop a high-level system architecture diagram and API contract (OpenAPI/Swagger) to ensure alignment between frontend, backend, and third-party integrations before any coding begins.
